summary: SKK Holdings Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement dated May 18, 2026, registering up to $5,540,009 of Class A ordinary shares for an at-the-market (ATM) offering through A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners as sales agent. The shares trade on Nasdaq under SKK; the last reported price on May 14, 2026 was $3.39. A.G.P. receives a 3.0% commission. This is a routine equity shelf takedown to raise capital, not a special-situation event like an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or strategic review. No change of control, tender offer, or issuer tender is involved. The filing is a standard capital markets transaction with no special-situation catalyst.
